title: ARSIA State Operations
description: Validates payload.args and payload.result for the 8 state operations defined in ARSIA-State.md §3. Base operations: GET, SET, DELETE, REVOKE (§3.1, §3.3.2). Complex operations: QUERY (§3.1.4), SNAPSHOT (§3.2.1), PURGE (§3.2.2), GRANT (§3.3.1). Discriminated by the payload.type field. Only enforces MUST-level structural constraints. Runtime constraints (namespace matching, legal_basis for personal PII, optimistic concurrency, value size limit, limit clamping to 1000, access control, elevated capabilities, key_pattern ownership, purge procedure, audit events) MUST be enforced programmatically.

state-key.description: Namespaced state key in format {agent-id}/{scope}/{local-key} per ARSIA-State.md §2.1.1.

set-scope.description: Scope for SET operations. MUST NOT be 'global' — agents cannot create global-scoped entries through SET. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2.

query-filter.description: Filter criteria shared between QUERY (§3.1.4) and SNAPSHOT (§3.2.1). All fields combined with AND logic. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.4.

created_after.description: RFC 3339 — entries created after this time.

created_before.description: RFC 3339 — entries created before this time.

get-args.description: Arguments for the GET operation per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.1.

key.description: Full namespaced key of the entry to retrieve.

get-result.description: Result for the GET operation: complete StateEntry object if found, null if the key does not exist, has been logically deleted, or has expired. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.1.

set-args.description: Arguments for the SET operation per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2. When pii_classification is 'personal', the compliance envelope of the request message MUST contain legal_basis (enforced programmatically). The serialized value MUST NOT exceed 1,048,576 bytes (enforced programmatically).

key.description: Full namespaced key. Agent-id prefix MUST match the request's 'from' field. Scope segment MUST match the scope field. Local-key MUST NOT start with the reserved 'arsiaprotocol.' prefix. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2, §2.2.

value.description: The data to store. Any valid JSON value (object, array, string, number, boolean, or null). Maximum serialized size 1,048,576 bytes (enforced programmatically). Per ARSIA-State.md §2.1.2, §2.3.

scope.description: Entry scope. MUST NOT be 'global'. MUST match the scope segment of the key. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2.

pii_classification.description: GDPR classification of the data. When 'personal' or 'sensitive', legal_basis MUST be present in the compliance envelope (enforced programmatically). When 'sensitive', pii_special_categories MUST be present. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2 rule 3.

pii_special_categories.description: GDPR Art. 9(1) special category types. REQUIRED when pii_classification is 'sensitive'. MUST NOT be present otherwise. Per ARSIA-State.md §2.1.11.

expires_at.description: Optional RFC 3339 expiry timestamp. Per ARSIA-State.md §2.1.7.

retention_days.description: Optional retention period override in days. Per ARSIA-State.md §2.1.8.

allOf.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 zone where the entry MUST be stored. Per ARSIA-State.md §2.1.9.

expected_version.description: For optimistic concurrency control. If set and does not match the current version, SET MUST be rejected with error code 'conflict'. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2 rule 4.

set-result.description: Result for the SET operation: complete StateEntry object with updated version, updated_at, and implementation-set fields. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.2.

delete-args.description: Arguments for the DELETE (logical delete) operation per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.3.

key.description: Full namespaced key of the entry to logically delete.

delete-result.description: Result for the DELETE operation per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.3.

deleted.description: Always true on successful logical deletion.

key.description: The key of the deleted entry.

query-args.description: Arguments for the QUERY operation per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.4. All fields are OPTIONAL — when no filters are provided, returns all entries accessible to the requesting agent. Limit values exceeding 1000 MUST be clamped to 1000 (not rejected) — enforced at runtime. Access control (agent can only see authorised entries) enforced at runtime.

key_prefix.description: Filter by key prefix (prefix match). Expected to be the most frequently used filter. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.4.

created_after.description: RFC 3339 — entries created after this time.

created_before.description: RFC 3339 — entries created before this time.

limit.description: Maximum entries to return. Default: 100. Values exceeding 1000 are clamped (not rejected) at runtime. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.4.

offset.description: Number of entries to skip. Default: 0. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.4.

query-result.description: Result for the QUERY operation. Results MUST be ordered by created_at ascending (enforced at runtime). Per ARSIA-State.md §3.1.4.

entries.description: Array of StateEntry objects matching the filters.

total.description: Total number of matching entries (before pagination).

limit.description: The limit used for this query.

offset.description: The offset used for this query.

snapshot-args.description: Arguments for the SNAPSHOT operation per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.1. Requires elevated capability arsiaprotocol.state.snapshot (enforced at runtime). MUST NOT be included in wildcard grants. The as_of timestamp MUST NOT be in the future (±300s clock skew tolerance) and MUST NOT predate the oldest retained version — enforced at runtime.

as_of.description: RFC 3339 timestamp — the point in time to snapshot. MUST NOT be in the future. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.1.

filter.description: Same filter fields as QUERY (§3.1.4). OPTIONAL.

snapshot-result.description: Result for the SNAPSHOT operation. Returns entries as they existed at the as_of timestamp. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.1. Snapshot responses MUST include the timestamp of the snapshot and a cryptographic hash of the state data for integrity verification per ARSIA-Actions.md §1.4 (arsiaprotocol.state.snapshot).

as_of.description: The as_of timestamp from the request (echoed back).

entries.description: Array of StateEntry objects as they existed at as_of.

timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the snapshot was generated. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §1.4.

hash.description: Cryptographic hash of the state data for integrity verification. Per ARSIA-Actions.md §1.4.

purge-args.description: Arguments for the PURGE operation per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2. Requires elevated capability arsiaprotocol.state.purge and ownership of the entry (enforced at runtime). PURGE permanently deletes the entry and all historical versions. A PURGE audit event MUST be generated regardless of audit_required (enforced at runtime). The capability MUST NOT be included in wildcard grants.

key.description: Full namespaced key of the entry to permanently purge.

purge-result.description: Result for the PURGE operation. Idempotent — purging an already-purged key returns success with the original purged_at timestamp. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.2.2.

key.description: The key of the purged entry.

purged_at.description: RFC 3339 timestamp of the purge operation.

grant-args.description: Arguments for the GRANT operation per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1. Creates an access grant allowing another agent to read or read-write specific state entries. The key_pattern MUST start with the granting agent's agent-id prefix (enforced at runtime). Requires arsiaprotocol.state.write capability.

key_pattern.description: Key or key prefix to share. Without trailing '*': exact match. With trailing '*': prefix match. MUST start with the granting agent's agent-id prefix. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

grantee_agent_id.description: Agent identifier of the grant recipient.

access_level.description: Access level: 'read' permits GET/QUERY, 'read_write' also permits SET. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

valid_until.description: RFC 3339 expiry timestamp for the grant. null means no expiry (revoke manually). Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

grant-result.description: Result for the GRANT operation. Returns the created grant with a UUID v4 identifier. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.1.

allOf.description: UUID v4 identifier for this grant.

valid_until.description: The grant expiry (echoed from request, or null).

revoke-args.description: Arguments for the REVOKE operation per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.2.

allOf.description: UUID of the grant to revoke.

revoke-result.description: Result for the REVOKE operation. Idempotent — revoking a non-existent or already-revoked grant returns success. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.3.2.

type.description: The payload.type field identifying the state operation. Per ARSIA-State.md §3.
